verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਫਲ ਨਮਿਤ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise banarai parafulat fal namit laagat hee fal patr puhap bilaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as trees and other vegetation grow for fruits and flowers but as soon as they bear fruits, their leaves and fruits drop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਰਚਿਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਨ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise treeaa rachit si(n)gaar bharataar het bheTat bharataar ur haar na samaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife adorns and embellishes herself for the love of her husband, but in his embrace, she doesn't even like the necklace she wears as it is considered an impediment in their complete union.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਲੀਲਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਭਏ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਸਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baalak achet jaise karat leelaa anek suchit chi(n)tan bhe sabai bisaraat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as an innocent child plays many games in his childhood but forgets them all once he grows up.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦੈ ਉਡ ਕਰਮ ਉਡਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise khaT karam dharam sram giaan kaaj giaan bhaan udhai udd karam uddaat hai ||405||

en.bdb: Similarly, the six forms of righteous deeds which are performed diligently for gaining knowledge, disappear like stars when the great knowledge of the Guru shines in its Sun like glory. All those deeds seem futile. (405)
